method: Direct WebFetch/WebSearch of ByteDance Seed's own blog and product page for the announcement claim (Tier 0, sufficient alone). Fresh verifier sub-agent independently confirmed the announcement text and searched for independent benchmark coverage of the capability claim (found none -- all coverage traces back to ByteDance's own figures). Fresh adversarial falsifier sub-agent checked for date/rehash issues, contradicting reports, and novelty-positioning risk; found none blocking, but flagged that academic systems (e.g. MiniCPM-o 4.5) have made similar simultaneous audio-visual claims around the same period, so the article avoids any 'first' framing.
origin_items: Surfaced in cycle 1's Tier-0 sweep as a new lead not yet in the ledger; also referenced in bytedance-seed-audio-1-0's 2026-08-05 note as a separate, unrelated product. Triaged and opened in cycle 2.

claims.text: On 5 August 2026, ByteDance's Seed team released SeedRealtime, a native audio-visual full-duplex model that natively fuses audio, video and text streams to enable real-time, proactive conversational interaction, deployed through the Doubao app; it extends Seed's audio-only full-duplex model ('Seed Full-Duplex Speech LLM'), released in April 2026, by adding vision
claims.reasoning: ByteDance's own blog post states this directly and is a Tier-0 primary source, sufficient alone for an announcement claim. Verifier sub-agent independently fetched the same page and product page and confirmed the date, name, and description with no embellishment. Falsifier sub-agent independently confirmed the April 2026 Seeduplex predecessor date and found no evidence of an earlier release under this name.

claims.text: ByteDance says SeedRealtime uses visual context to resolve spoken-word ambiguity and, per its own human evaluation, substantially reduces awkward pacing and interruption problems compared with older cascaded (non-end-to-end) voice-assistant pipelines
claims.reasoning: Verifier sub-agent searched for independent benchmark/hands-on coverage and found none -- all secondary coverage (MarkTechPost, TestingCatalog, DataNorth, an explainx Substack) restates ByteDance's own reported human-evaluation figures with no disclosed methodology or third-party test, and cryptobriefing.com (a blocked_evidence_domain) also only restated the vendor claim. Labeled vendor-claim, not confirmed.

falsifier_notes: PASS with caveat. No evidence of date manipulation, rehash, or denial. Confirmed ByteDance Seed is a real, active lab. Flagged that academic systems (e.g. MiniCPM-o 4.5, arXiv 2604.27393) claim similar simultaneous audio-visual full-duplex interaction around the same period -- article deliberately avoids implying industry-first novelty, only that it extends ByteDance's own April 2026 audio-only model. Dedup-check run before opening: no matches (clean).
